description: Comparing the Jones-Ocneanu Markov-trace Schur coefficients (solved from tr_M(1)=1, tr_M(σ_0)=z, tr_M(σ_0σ_1)=z² at q_0) to the Wedderburn-normalized weights used in full-tower-mass.py. They differ by factors of 2.4× to 7.3×. The std channel is OVER-weighted by 2.4× in the code convention — partly explaining the empirical ρ(std, A=3) < 1.

std_irrep_characters.note: chi_std of trefoil σ_0σ_1σ_0 vanishes EXACTLY at all q — potentially relevant to shell-closure resonance at doubly-magic 4He

schur_coefficients_H3_q0.constraint: tr_M(W) = S_sym · χ_sym(W) + S_std · χ_std(W) + S_alt · χ_alt(W)

interpretation.formula_should_use: possibly schur (for true Markov trace), or a product combining both

gap.remaining_explanation_required: Additional ≈ 6× for T, ≈ 1.6× for 3He — possibly from per-gen Markov trace structure at A=3 with only 2 generators, or from Yang-Baxter/braid-relation constraints that don't fully operate at A=3
